content_sections.heading: About Theni District Health Society
content_sections.text: Theni District Health Society is the district-level health body of Theni district, Tamil Nadu, under the Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department. The notice invites applications for contract posts in the society, including posts in its AYUSH, NRHM and NAM wings and The Rights Project. The society's office is in the Multi-department Office Complex, Theni District - 625531, and its telephone number is 04546 - 261403.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 76 vacancies in 18 posts. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

rows.post: Special Educator for Behaviour Therapy (The Rights Project)
Multi Purpose Health Worker / Health Inspector - Grade - II (MTM, UHWC and PHC)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The table gives the shorter post-wise requirements as printed. Posts 1, 3, 4 and 6 have longer conditions, given in their own blocks after the table. Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's degree in Special Education (D.Ed / B.Ed / M.Ed) from a UGC-recognized University. All persons should have live RCI (Rehabilitation Council of India) registration with a valid number. First-level priority may be given to B.Ed / M.Ed specialization in Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD) such as Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD), Specific Learning Disability (SLD), and Intellectual Disability (ID), Mental Retardation etc. Second-level priority may be given to B.Ed / M.Ed specialization in Visual Impairment (HI) i.e others. Third-level priority may be given for Diploma in Special Education. Essential: Bachelor's Degree (OR) Recognized sanitary inspector's course. Essential: certificate course in computer operation (minimum 2 months). Essential: permanent two wheeler driving license, and the candidate should be able to drive a two wheeler. Preferential: Tuberculosis health visitor's recognized course; Govt. recognized degree/diploma in social work (or) Medical Social work; successful completion of basic training course (Govt. recognized) for Multi-purpose health workers. Graduate degree holder in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 3 years of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programme. OR Post Graduate in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human development / Nursing. If the candidate is a person living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV): graduate degree holder in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human development / Nursing with 1 year of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programmes. Must have passed plus two with Biology or Botany and Zoology. Must have passed Tamil Language as a subject at S.S.L.C level. Must possess two years for Multipurpose Health Worker (Male) / Inspector / Sanitary Inspector Course Training, offered by a recognized private Institution / Trust / Universities / Deemed Universities including Gandhigram Rural Institute, with a Training Course Certificate granted by the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Theni District Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 76 vacancies in 18 posts. The largest numbers are 25 for Multi Purpose Health Worker / Health Inspector - Grade - II and 12 for Therapeutic Assistant (AYUSH Wing).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 05:45 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application for the post, with self-attested copies of the certificates, to the District Health Officer, District Health Office, Multi-department Office Complex, Block No. 1, Behind District Collectorate, Theni - 625 531.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 50 Years for Multi Purpose Health Worker / Health Inspector - Grade - II and MLHP, and 40 Years for all other posts. The notice prints no age cut-off date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: It ranges from 8,950/- for Multipurpose Worker (AYUSH Wing) to 40,000/- for Medical Officer (AYUSH NRHM Wing). Each post's amount is in the pay table.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Hospital Worker and Multipurpose Worker?
faq.answer: Hospital Worker needs 8th Pass. Multipurpose Worker (AYUSH Wing) and Multipurpose Worker (AYUSH NRHM Wing) need 8th Std Completed.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for Medical Officer (AYUSH NRHM Wing)?
faq.answer: The notice requires a degree in BSMS. There are 2 vacancies at 40,000/- a month.

faq.question: Q8. Is Tamil required for Multi Purpose Health Worker / Health Inspector - Grade - II?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must have passed Tamil Language as a subject at S.S.L.C level, along with plus two with Biology or Botany and Zoology.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract basis and entirely temporary. The notice states they will not be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q10. Will applications sent by post after 27 November 2026 be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications received by post after 27 November 2026 will not be accepted.
